ayahs.1: Badi kharabi hai naap-tol mein kami karne walon ki.
ayahs.2: Ke jab logon se naap kar lete hain to poora poora lete hain.
ayahs.3: Aur jab unhein naap kar ya tol kar dete hain to kam dete hain.
ayahs.4: Kya unhein apne marne ke baad ji uthne ka khayaal nahin.
ayahs.6: Jis din sab log Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke saamne khade honge.
ayahs.7: Yaqeenan bad-kaaron ka naama-e-aamaal Sijjeen mein hai.
ayahs.8: Tujhe kya maloom Sijjeen kya hai?
ayahs.10: Us din jhutlaane walon ki badi kharabi hai.
ayahs.11: Jo jaza-o-saza ke din ko jhutlaate rahe.
ayahs.12: Use sirf wohi jhutlaata hai jo hadd se aage nikal jaane wala (aur) gunahgaar hota hai.
ayahs.13: Jab us ke saamne hamari aayaten padhi jaati hain to keh deta hai ke yeh aglon ke afsaane hain.
ayahs.14: Yoon nahin, balke un ke dilon par un ke aamaal ki wajah se zang (chadh gaya) hai.
ayahs.15: Hargiz nahin, yeh log us din apne Rabb se oat mein rakhe jaaenge.
ayahs.16: Phir yeh log bil-yaqeen jahannam mein jhonke jaaenge.
ayahs.17: Phir keh diya jaayega ke yehi hai woh jise tum jhutlaate rahe.
ayahs.18: Hargiz nahin, be-shak neko-kaaron ke aamaal-naame Illiyeen mein hain.
ayahs.19: Aur tujhe kya pata ke Illiyeen kya hai?
ayahs.21: Muqarrab (farishte) is ka mushaahida karte hain.
ayahs.22: Yaqeenan nek log (badi) naimaton mein honge.
ayahs.23: Musahriyon par baithe dekh rahe honge.
ayahs.24: Tu un ke chehron se hi naimaton ki taro-taazgi pehchaan lega.
ayahs.25: Yeh log sar-ba-mohr khaalis sharaab pilaaye jaaenge.
ayahs.26: Jis par mushk ki mohr hogi, sabqat le jaane walon ko isi mein sabqat karni chaahiye.
ayahs.27: Aur is ki aamezish Tasneem ki hogi.
ayahs.28: (Yani) woh chashma jis ka paani muqarrab log piyenge.
ayahs.29: Gunahgaar log imaan walon ki hansi udaya karte the.
ayahs.30: Aur un ke paas se guzarte hue aapas mein aankh ke ishaare karte the.
ayahs.31: Aur jab apne walon ki taraf lautte to dil-lagiyan karte the.
ayahs.32: Aur jab unhein dekhte to kehte, yaqeenan yeh log gumrah (be-raah) hain.
ayahs.33: Yeh un par paasbaan bana kar to nahin bheje gaye.
ayahs.34: Pas aaj imaan wale in kaafiron par hansenge.
ayahs.35: Takhton par baithe dekh rahe honge.
ayahs.36: Ke ab in munkiron ne jaisa yeh karte the poora poora badla pa liya.
